provenance.reference: Original 5x5 border concept sheet generated in this chat
provenance.method: Each motif was extracted individually with transparent_background=true. Selected outputs were corrected to remove white interior fills or clipped edges. Original generated PNG files are copied unchanged; alpha-bound cropping and tinting happen in the renderer.

Edit target: the attached original 5x5 numbered label-border design sheet. design 09, second row fourth column: extract ONLY the LARGE upper-left ginkgo fan leaf with its curved short stem. Preserve the delicate radiating veins. Exclude other leaves. Faithfully extract and clean up this original illustration, preserving its original silhouette, proportions, expressive details and black ink line style; do not redesign it. Deliver ONE isolated high-resolution transparent PNG with clean antialiased black strokes, tightly framed with a small even transparent margin. Remove all text, numbers, unrelated art and every bit of the label frame. All white background, including white interior regions of the line drawing, must become genuinely transparent. No baseline, surrounding box, gray background, checkerboard pixels, color, shadows or extra objects.
